messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — saw a ~18% token/sec regression on the H100 rolling canary after the new kernel-picker change landed. Metric spikes at 99th latency too. Any immediate suspects?

maria: Ack, saw alerts. I pulled a profile from the canary node. Primary change was autotuner choosing larger tile_size for medium sequences (128-512) which bumped per-thread smem and regs.

david: Larger tile => higher L1/shared per-block, so occupancy down. On H100 that can kill throughput for tiny batches. Do we have numbers?

maria: Quick diff from perf trace:
```
old: tile=64, occupancy=0.72, regs=64, smem=20KB, tokens/s=110k
new: tile=128, occupancy=0.42, regs=90, smem=32KB, tokens/s=90k
```
regression correlates with drop in warps/SM.

ashwin: That matches my local repro. Also saw KV-cache path doing aggressive prefetch for same seqlens which adds key cache arrays to per-thread regs. Combined reg pressure -> spill in a few kernels.

katie: Can you point to the exact autotune rule that flipped? I want to see the decision boundary.

maria: It's the sequence_length gating rule: if median_seq >= 96 && median_seq < 512 then prefer tile=128 for improved DP throughput. The selector's cost model underestimated register pressure on H100.

ashwin: Short-term fix: add an architecture override so H100/driver family penalizes tile sizes that push regs > 80. That should restore occupancy. Longer-term we should extend cost model to include KV prefetch register usage.

david: Agreed. Also batching heuristics: when batch_size <= 8 we should bias toward smaller tile even if seqlen favors larger tiles. That keeps latency SLOs.

katie: I'll open a tiny rollback PR to disable the canary rule for H100 and small-batch paths.

maria: For tracking: attaching microprofile snippets here (pasted):
```
Kernel: attn_fwd_v2
device: h100
batch: 6
seq: 128
regs: 92 -> spill: yes
smem_per_block: 32768
occupancy: 0.41
```
We also see KV-cache prefetch adds ~12 regs on average.

ashwin: Good catch on prefetch. We should annotate autotuner cost_model with estimated kv_regs and smem_kv_static so decisions reflect combined footprint.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy-472: noticed 3% error rate increase, rolling paused.

david: Postmortem action items: (1) PR to add arch penalty for H100 in selector, (2) adjust small-batch bias in batching heuristics, (3) update cost model to include KV-prefetch/reg accounting, (4) add a regression unit-test that simulates KV prefetch + tile combos.

katie: I'll own 1+2. Ashwin/Maria can own 3. David will add test scaffolding?

maria: Yep. I'll start on cost model changes and a quick local sim to validate.

ashwin: Thanks all. Once rollback PR is up, let's run a canary with KV-prefetch disabled to isolate. :thumbsup:
